speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you are presenting with fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. To determine the cause of these concerning symptoms, have you noticed if the lymph nodes are hard, fixed, or tender to the touch?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma. The combination of supraclavicular lymphadenopathy with "B symptoms" (fever, night sweats, weight loss) and abdominal pain is highly suggestive of this malignancy, which can also involve the liver causing abdominal discomfort. Further staging with CT imaging and biopsy would be the next logical steps.
